name: agentfloat-contracts
description: AgentFloat — budget-controlled MUSD treasury for AI agents on Mezo (testnet chain 31611)

scripts.//standalone: These three need no Hardhat — plain ethers, so they start instantly and dodge the Hardhat 3.x / Node 20 trap entirely. They poll the chain instead of awaiting tx.wait(), which hangs on the Mezo testnet RPC.
scripts.//resume: Undo an EMERGENCY STOP: unpause the treasury on chain, then release float back to the agent. Order matters — fundAgent is whenNotPaused, so the unpause has to land first. REFUND_MUSD=5 or SKIP_FUND=1 to tune.

//pinning: Hardhat is deliberately pinned to ^2 (latest is 3.x, which uses an incompatible ESM config format). chai is pinned to ^4 because chai 5+ is ESM-only and breaks CommonJS Hardhat 2 tests. Mezo docs specify solc 0.8.28 + evmVersion london — see hardhat.config.js.
